name: Can smart lighting systems be integrated into an existing living room setup?

mainEntity.name: Can smart lighting systems be integrated into an existing living room setup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, smart lighting systems can often be integrated into an existing living room setup. This can involve replacing existing bulbs with smart bulbs, installing smart dimmer switches, or incorporating smart fixtures. Many systems connect wirelessly via Wi-Fi or Bluetooth, allowing control through a smartphone app, voice commands, or smart home hubs. The extent of integration depends on your current electrical infrastructure and desired level of automation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Smart lighting can integrate by replacing bulbs, installing smart switches, or using smart fixtures, connecting wirelessly for app or voice control.
